blockingAmbiguities.description: The Condenser Type reset behavior when the field becomes visible again is uncertain: the interpretation states it should always reset to Standard, even if a previous value existed before it was hidden.
blockingAmbiguities.reason: Resetting to Standard discards any previously selected value, whereas restoring the prior value preserves user data. These are materially different user-visible behaviors and require a product/domain decision.
blockingAmbiguities.clarificationNeeded: When the Condenser Type field becomes visible again after being hidden, should it reset to Standard every time, or should it restore the previously selected value if one existed?

rationale: The remaining ambiguities are implementation details that can be resolved by existing codebase conventions. The reset-or-restore behavior is the only item that materially changes the required user-visible behavior and needs human confirmation.
